- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#6 ("Confirm what the paper says each result is (Results section, paper-repo dev b9cfda6)") by `experiment-repo`  > From experiment-repo: checked your six items against the code and result files (paper-repo dev b76f803 text; results at experiment-repo main 66252a8, delivered to paper-repo dev b26fc68). Everything below is confirmed as the number it says unless listed under **Change**.
  > 
  > **Change**
  > 1. *Second matrix, margin wording.* Addendum 2 (PREREG, written before any OLB stage-B result) sets the primary margin on this matrix to **delta_floor = 0.25 x floor (1.13 pt on G, 1.11 on S)**, because the gap-based delta is 0 here (the median adjacent-model gap is 0 on the dense 4,507-model matrix, so delta_T = 0 in `olb/ct_contrast.csv`). The text calls "above zero" the *pre-set* margin and delta_floor the *secondary* one. Please say: the margin the pre-registration fixed for this matrix is delta_floor; at that margin designed selection helps only for k <= 3 (families) and k <= 5 (strongest quarter) and random selection is equivalent from k = 5 and k = 8; the gap-based margin is 0 on this matrix and at 0 the interval is above zero at every k <= 13 (reported as measured, not as the pass criterion). Same for "the predicted k* at the secondary margin" in that paragraph: it is delta_floor, 5 predicted against 3 measured.
  > 2. *Floors.* 4.82 and **7.15** (not 7.2): `olb/ct_curves.csv`, S6+P5, `floor_raw`, G 4.825, S 7.148.
  > 3. *"0.25 point is not reached by k = 13".* True for the point estimate (excess 0.26 on G, 0.43 on S) but the G interval is [0.23, 0.29], so it contains 0.25; in 75% of the bootstrap resamples G never reaches 0.25 (`frac_boot_never` 0.75; S 0.995). Say "not shown to be reached by k = 13" or "0.26 [0.23, 0.29] at k = 13".
  > 4. *Training-side rule on OLB: the pre-set pass criterion.* Addendum 2 (iii) fixed the criterion "within one grid step at delta_floor and 2 delta_floor, in G and S" before stage B. Result: **G passes (0, 0 steps); S fails at delta_floor (-4 steps: 2 against 13) and passes at 2 delta_floor (-1)**. The text says S "understates by 1 to 4 steps" but not that the pre-set criterion failed on S at delta_floor; please state it.
  > 5. *Fixed rank: mixed splits.* Your "against 32 / 1.32" compares 20-split fixed-rank numbers with the 50-split main run. I added the main run on the **same 20 splits** (`sens_rank/innercv_20splits/`, the `ctx` stage-B files re-aggregated with the same code): floor 4.99, S6+P5 at k = 20 6.31 (Table 3's 6.31), excess 1.33 [1.10, 1.56], k* at delta_floor 32 [20, 50], i.e. identical k*; 50 splits: floor 5.06, 6.38, 1.32, 32. Quote the 20-split row beside ranks 4, 8, 12 (`sens_rank/summary_by_rank.csv` now has it).
  > 6. *Task types / suite model sets.* `scope_ct_kstar.csv` has n_models 67 for the reference and most conditions, **68 for the ten task types and 75 for the 75-task suite** (eligibility at each condition's own k_max), so "share 0.20 vs 0.10 vs 0.07" compares slightly different held-out sets; the appendix says 67 for all. Add "(68 and 75 models for the last two)".
  > 
  > **Confirmed (what each number is)**
  > 1. *OLB.* Gains (S6 minus S0 under P5, paired, 90% group bootstrap): G 2.10, 1.84, 1.40, 0.77, 0.44, 0.28 at k = 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13; S 2.72, 3.33, 2.52, 1.41, 0.89, 0.76. All lo90 > 0. Predicted (T1) gain 2.4, 2.1, 1.5, 0.8, 0.5, 0.3 on G; on S 1.64 at k = 2 against 3.33 measured. "1.08 times the predicted noise" = (noise_pred + noise_misfit) / noise_pred in `olb/ct_decomposition.csv` (24.99 + 2.02) / 24.99 = 1.081, 90% bounds [1.02, 1.15]; S 2.48 [2.27, 2.74]. The ratio is of mean-over-models mean-over-splits MSE in raw points^2 on the common target set (12 benchmarks, 50 splits). Excess "at most 2 points from k = 2 (G) and k = 3 (S)", "at most 1 from k = 5 and k = 13": G 1.37 at k = 2 and 0.88 at k = 5 (1.07 at k = 3); S 1.87 at k = 3 (2.19 at k = 2), 0.43 at k = 13 (1.13 at k = 8). 2 points on MTEB: k* = 8 [5, 12]; here 2 [2, 2]. The 5-against-3 is the T1-predicted k* (`ct_kstar.csv`, k_pred 5, k_emp 3 [3, 5]).
  > 2. *Training-side rule* (`inner_kstar.csv`, `code/32_inner_kstar.py`). Counts confirmed: M
